sources.snippet: However, to train a model with capabilities comparable to that of an English model in this way, presumably a similar amount of compute to what was used to train the English model would be required. To address this issue, we introduce WECHSEL,<sup>1</sup> a novel method to transfer monolingual language models to a new language.
